subject: Phase 100480: Benchmark Runner Build (LongMemEval-style and LoCoMo-style)
verdict_justification: The benchmark runner harness (am-bench) satisfies all requirements from Phase 100480 and benchmark.md §5 without product regression. Both suite adapters (LoCoMo and LongMemEval) preserve categories and abstention semantics, two-pass LLM judging applies geometric-mean positional bias mitigation at temperature 0.0, the three remaining suites are cleanly documented as stubs, and canary baselines were produced reproducibly against pinned snapshots.
standard: AC-100480-01: Both suite adapters work with correct stream and question parsing
AC-100480-02: One-command reproducible scoring against pinned snapshots
AC-100480-03: Calibrated two-tier LLM-as-a-judge with swap-position geometric-mean bias mitigation
AC-100480-04: First baselines recorded with pinned datasets and judge settings
AC-100480-05: Three remaining suites remain documented stubs (BEAM, MemoryAgentBench, AMA-Bench)
AC-100480-06: No product regression; full workspace check and coverage gates pass
AGENTS.md & benchmark strategy constraints: zero dependencies beyond stdlib, no committed datasets/secrets, roadmap isolation

requirements.evidence: am_bench/datasets/locomo.py and am_bench/datasets/longmemeval.py parse pinned snapshots preserving categories, timestamps, and abstention semantics. 116 tests pass in benchmarks/tests/.
python3 benchmarks/run.py runs end to end with pinned snapshots, producing structured JSON and Markdown scorecards.
